description: dgem regression matrix v2, the successor to v1 (frozen as of 2026-10-03): v1 plus /v1/systemone equivalents of the dgem-CLI suites, a mixed-polarity yes/no suite, the image suites vision/vision_spot (T1/T2) and a TC (model comparison) tier. Competitor targets (--competitor) run only suites whose kind is in competitor_kinds and never get verdicts. Suites marked "accuracy": true are scored per item. Changing what is in a tier means a new matrix version, never an edit. See docs/operate/regression-matrix.md and docs/operate/model-comparison.md.

health.description: /health: status ok, vLLM ready; records version, revision, vLLM commit

contract.description: scripts/contract_diff.py cases (valid, edge, error, multilingual with known answers)

calibration.description: calibration suite, dgem's production prompt path

massive_spot.description: MASSIVE validation split, ru/th/hi/ja/es x 20, 20 options (non-Latin input on /v1/systemone)

jev_systemone.description: JevBench via /v1/systemone with native noul/choice/score types

latency.description: /v1/systemone keep-alive: q1, q5, q10, long_q1, q5_s4 x 100; sweep q1/q5 at 16 and 32 workers, >= 256 requests

typed.description: LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions test: 400 cases x 5 questions in one request

order.description: option order: MASSIVE-en 200, emotion 200, XNLI-en 200, JevBench choice 139; identical repeat + one shuffle + reversed

decision_index.description: Decision Index stand-in panel (wide options, many slots)

di_probes.description: Decision Index adapter (dgem systemone serve, this checkout's binary) against the target: wide options at K=27/41/61/101/151/255 (answer + complete probabilities summing to 1), 12-question slot batching, ~31k-token input must answer or refuse with HTTP 422 and a kit marker

di_wide.description: MASSIVE validation (English) with the full ~60-label set as options, through the adapter's bracket routing

di_kit_compat.description: Decision Index kit compatibility pass (86 requests) through the adapter; runs only when DGEM_DI_KIT_DIR and DGEM_DI_COMPAT_ROWS are set, otherwise reported as skipped

di_catchall.description: CLINC150 validation (80 in-scope + 20 out-of-scope) in the Decision Index format, 151 options with an 'out of scope' catch-all, through the adapter; tracks in-scope answered as out-of-scope

rag_dev.description: RAGTruth train (66 per task), the Decision Index hallucination wording with true/false criteria, through the adapter; tracks the yes/no 'no' bias (macro-F1 and recall on the hallucinated class)

calib_systemone.description: calibration suite (benchmarks/calibration_suite.jsonl) as /v1/systemone bodies: the same items as `calibration`, runnable on any decision model; score items graded exactly on the nearest level

intents_systemone.description: banking77 (30 options) + clinc150 slices as /v1/systemone bodies with every option; dgem through the adapter's bracket routing, competitors directly

gate_mixed_noul.description: 51 tool-call review cases, two yes/no questions per request with mostly opposite-polarity answers (EXP-23); the report also counts cross-slot answer coupling

gate_mixed_noul_single.description: the same 102 questions, one per request: separates question difficulty from cross-slot coupling

vision_spot.description: multi-aspect image decisions (EXP-22): first 40 items of the seeded synthetic sweep, six aspects in one pass

vision.description: multi-aspect image decisions (EXP-22) on the 230-item seeded synthetic sweep (benchmarks/bbox_sweep.jsonl): presence, 3x3 grid cell, count, relation, quality, occlusion; gated per answer like the text suites

excluded.bench-rerank: shells out to dgem decide sequentially and does not take a Vertex URL or token; add after it reads -u/-k
excluded.bench-permutation: 16 synthetic items; covered by the order suite

reference.note: Accuracy ranges = min..max of per-run accuracy over two T2 sessions with the v0.2.0 server: production Vertex G4 (image 658ad8ee, 2026-10-02) and the release-gate canary (e37012a, same server code). Frozen sets have one run per session: min..max of the two values +/- 2 standard errors. Used in single-target mode; a REVIEW is within reference_slack below the range. Previous (v0.1.3) reference: benchmarks/runs/20261001-v013-reference-{t1,t2}. coverage = the highest answered share in the v0.1.3 and v0.2.0 reference runs (every suite answered every item under v0.1.3; jev_native lost one long_policy item to the 4,096-token context under v0.2.0's layout, so v0.2.0 at 4k reviews on coverage until the context is raised). v2 adds suites without reference ranges yet (INFO verdicts until a v2 reference run is recorded).

vision.note: per-answer accuracy over 230 sweep items x their aspects; 4 runs on production Vertex G4 v0.2.0, 2026-10-03 (EXP-22 phase 4 x2 + runs/20261003-vision-gate-ref x2)

tc_note: TC = evidence level E2 of docs/operate/model-comparison.md: run with --target dgem=<url> --baseline dgem --competitor <name>=<url>#profile=<name>. For E3 add a single scored T2 run (--confirm) after the E2 report is written.
